description: Additive payment metric catalog. The original catalog hash and primitive receipts remain valid. Stage boundaries differ between SLH wallet workflows and classical transaction controls.

payment_prepare_persist_ns.description: SLH WatchStore payment preparation including its durable journal writes and production transaction/digest preparation.

payment_sign_persist_ns.description: SLH WatchStore signing including mandatory signature verification and durable journal writes; not isolated signature primitive time.

payment_assemble_persist_ns.description: SLH WatchStore payment assembly including authorization assembly and durable journal writes.

payment_assembly_ns.description: Classical transaction-control assembly only; does not exercise the SLH wallet journal or persistent payment workflow.

payment_sign_ns.description: Classical transaction-control signing; does not include a durable wallet journal.

payment_verify_ns.description: All-input verification: production TransactionContext for SLH; benchmark classical script-aware control using production secp256k1 and sighash APIs. Neither is full node validation. Independent verification is untimed and separate.

payment_total_ns.description: Enclosing foreground payment interval, including generated inventory work when selected. Independently observed, never a sum of stage quantiles; excludes independent artifact checks.

input_count.description: Number of transparent inputs in this complete payment.

signature_count.description: Number of authorization signatures across this complete payment.

payment_inventory_ns.description: Foreground inventory preparation for generated mode, including SLH wallet creation, key derivation, policy enrollment and verified backup publication. Cached inventory is prepared outside timing and omits this metric; not a measured zero.

payment_wallet_setup_ns.description: Fresh SLH wallet setup within the foreground interval, including its actual storage initialization. Cached inventory does not mean a warm existing wallet database.
